VN.feeBasis: A new work permit's provincial fee, about 600,000 to 1,000,000 dong by locality (Circular 85/2019/TT-BTC); the low end is charged.
VN.daysBasis: Ten working days under Decree 219/2025/ND-CP, issued by the province since August 7, 2025.
VN.stayBasis: A work permit runs at most two years.

sources.what: Viet An Law, state fee for a work permit: 600,000 to 1,000,000 VND for a new permit, by province
Vietnam Briefing, work permits from August 2025 (Decree 219/2025/ND-CP): ten working days, provincial issuance

NP.feeBasis: The Department of Labour's fee for a work permit of up to six months (NPR 20,000 beyond); the non-tourist visa follows separately.
NP.daysBasis: Issued within 30 days of paying the fee; 30 to 45 days in all, by law firms' guides.
NP.stayBasis: The fee charged covers up to six months.

sources.what: Bhandari & Associates, work permit in Nepal: NPR 15,000 up to six months, NPR 20,000 beyond; issued within 30 days of the fee
Nepal Laws, hiring foreign employees: 30 to 45 days

GH.feeBasis: The Ghana Immigration Service's one-year work permit for a non-ECOWAS national (raised from USD 500), before the residence permit.

sources.what: Fragomen, Ghana: the work permit for other nationalities rose from USD 500 to USD 1,000
Mondaq, Ghana work and residence permit guide: non-ECOWAS one year $1,000

BH.feeBasis: The LMRA's annual work permit issuance fee for 2026 under Edict (79) of 2025, rising in stages to BD 125 by 2029; monthly fees follow.

sources.what: LocalBH, Edict (79) of 2025: the annual work permit fee BD 111 in 2026, BD 125 by 2029
EY, Bahrain raises work permit fees from January 1, 2026

PH.feeBasis: The Bureau of Immigration's Special Work Permit for work of under six months, which covers performers and film crews: about ₱6,440 (₱6,400 by the Senate's 2019 account).
PH.stayBasis: Granted for three months, extendable once for three more.

sources.what: Translayte, Work permits in the Philippines: the Special Work Permit costs PHP 6,440
Inquirer, 2019: the regular fee for a special work permit is P6,400
Fragomen: SWP granted for three months initially, extendable once for three months

TW.feeBasis: The Ministry of Labor's review fee for a work permit for artistic and performing work, NT$500 a case.
TW.daysBasis: Reviewed in seven working days from the day after it's received when filed online (twelve on paper), about nine calendar days.

sources.what: Taipei City Government, artistic and performing work permit application (2018): review fee NT$500 a case, twelve working days
104, Resources for working in Taiwan: the Ministry of Labor completes the review within 7 working days
Taiwan News: applying online for a work permit shortens review to seven working days, artists included

ID.feeBasis: The non-tax state revenue fee for a C7 visit visa for arts and culture, 30 days (PP No. 45/2024).
ID.daysBasis: Five working days once the visa fee is paid, by the Directorate General's page for the visa.
ID.stayBasis: A stay of up to 30 days, not extendable.

sources.what: Directorate General of Immigration, C7 visit visa for arts and cultural performance: 30 days, Rp 1,500,000, five working days after payment

EC.feeBasis: The Foreign Ministry's fees for the temporary residence visa for an athlete, artist or cultural manager: $50 to apply and $270 when it's granted (January 2026).

sources.what: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y Movilidad Humana, temporary residence visa for an athlete, artist or cultural manager: application USD 50, grant USD 270; two years

RS.feeBasis: The single residence and work permit's RSD 420 to submit and RSD 22,700 for the permit, by the government's Welcome to Serbia portal.
RS.stayBasis: A single permit for up to a year.

sources.what: Welcome to Serbia, user manuals: submission fee RSD 420; temporary residence and single permit fee RSD 22,700
Global Citizen Solutions, Serbia residence permit 2026: application and approval fees of about the same amount
